evals.prompt: 매일 오전 9시에 기한이 지난 미완료 작업을 담당자에게 Slack DM으로 알려주는 Jira 자동화 생성해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the Jira convention and project context, checks for an equivalent rule, creates the narrow scheduled project-scoped automation, saves and reopens it, and does not manually trigger a notification.
expectations: docs/team-rules/jira-convention.md is read before Automation mutation.
An equivalent existing rule is searched before creation.
The schedule uses 09:00 Asia/Seoul and project-scoped overdue JQL.
The notification targets each issue's actual assignee.
The saved rule is reopened and verified as enabled.
The rule is not manually run and no test Slack message is sent.

evals.prompt: 새 작업이 생기면 담당자별 하위 작업을 자동으로 만드는 Jira 자동화 생성해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies that new subtasks are prohibited, makes no Jira Automation mutation, and asks one compact question to confirm independently completable standard issues and their Epic or issue-link relationship.
expectations: The live Jira convention's new-subtask prohibition is cited as the blocker.
No rule is created, saved, enabled, or manually run.
The request is not silently converted to another issue type.
One compact clarification asks for the standard-ticket relationship or independently completable scopes.

evals.prompt: 기존 '하위 작업 템플릿 생성' 자동화의 설명 문구만 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects the existing rule, detects its prohibited subtask-creation action, and stops without preserving or editing the enabled policy-violating rule unless migration or disabling is separately authorized.
expectations: The full existing rule is inspected before editing.
The prohibited subtask-creation action is reported even though the requested delta is wording-only.
No text, enabled state, trigger, or action is mutated without migration or disabling authorization.
The response asks only for the policy-resolution decision.

evals.prompt: 주간 Jira 요약 자동화의 프롬프트에서 링크만 제거해줘. 직접 실행하거나 Slack으로 테스트 메시지는 보내지 마.
evals.expected_output: The skill updates only the requested prompt constraint, preserves schedule, destination, actions, and enabled state, reopens the rule for verification, and performs no live run or notification.
expectations: The summary prompt reference is loaded.
Only the link-formatting requirement is changed.
Schedule, destination, other prompt constraints, actions, and enabled state are preserved.
The saved rule is reopened and verified.
No manual run or Slack notification occurs.

evals.prompt: 매주 월요일 오전 9시에 미완료 작업을 조회하는 Jira 자동화를 비활성 초안으로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates the requested rule as a disabled draft, reopens it, and verifies the disabled state without enabling or running it.
expectations: The explicit disabled-draft request is preserved.
The rule is saved and verified as disabled.
The common completion checks do not require it to be enabled.
The rule is not manually run.

evals.prompt: 새 사용자 가치 스토리가 생성되면 FE·BE·AI 구현 티켓을 자동으로 나누는 Jira 자동화 생성해줘. 각 담당자, 기한, Story Points는 규칙 입력값으로 제공돼.
evals.expected_output: The skill preserves one domain-neutral Story and creates three prefixed standard Tasks with required fields and relationships instead of cloning Stories or creating subtasks.
expectations: The Automation rule never creates a subtask.
The trigger Story remains one domain-neutral user-value issue and is not cloned by area.
The created issues are `[FE]`, `[BE]`, and `[AI]` Tasks with exactly one assignee, due date, and allowed Story Points each.
Each created Task is connected to the same Epic and `Relates` to the Story; `Blocks` is used only for configured sequencing.
Every created Task has a non-empty purpose, concrete work, and observable completion criteria.
The saved rule is reopened and verified without a manual run.

evals.prompt: FE와 BE가 함께 쓰는 API 계약 생성 기반 작업을 만드는 Jira 자동화를 생성해줘. 담당자는 이종철, 기한은 트리거일로부터 7일 뒤, Story Points는 2로 설정하고 단일 영역 작업에는 적용하지 마.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates a standard `[COMMON]` Task only for the shared FE/BE foundation and does not generalize the prefix to single-domain or standalone work.
expectations: The created issue is a standard Task, never a subtask.
`[COMMON]` is used because the result is shared by at least FE and BE.
The rule scope prevents the action from applying to single-domain or standalone work.
One assignee, due date, allowed Story Points, and applicable relationships are configured before enabling.
The created Task has a non-empty purpose, concrete work, and observable completion criteria.
The saved rule is reopened and not manually run.

evals.prompt: 중간발표 자료 정리 작업을 자동 생성하는 Jira 자동화를 만들어줘. 담당자는 나, 기한은 2026-08-10, Story Points는 2이고 다른 티켓과의 관계는 필요 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates an unprefixed standalone Task action with no forced relationship and a complete description.
expectations: No `[FE]`, `[BE]`, `[AI]`, or `[COMMON]` prefix is invented.
No Epic or issue link is forced because the standalone work has no requested relationship.
The issue action configures one assignee, due date, allowed Story Points, purpose, concrete work, and observable completion criteria.
The saved rule is reopened and not manually run.

evals.prompt: 같은 사용자 가치를 `[FE]`, `[BE]`, `[AI]` 스토리로 복제하는 Jira 자동화를 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill makes no Automation mutation and asks one compact correction question about one shared Story plus prefixed Tasks.
expectations: Ownership-only Story cloning is identified as a policy conflict.
No rule is created, saved, or enabled before the issue-role correction is confirmed.
The skill does not silently convert Stories to Tasks or strip prefixes.
